mapper.insert: INSERT INTO defense_answers (defense_id, question_id, sq_id, student_answer, score, feedback, created_at) VALUES (#{defenseId}, #{questionId}, #{sqId}, #{studentAnswer}, #{score}, #{feedback}, #{createdAt})
mapper.update: update defense_records set feedback = #{feedback}, video_analysis = CASE WHEN analysis_source = 'video' THEN video_analysis ELSE #{videoAnalysis} END, report_analysis = #{reportAnalysis}, score = #{score}, updated_at = NOW() where defense_id = #{defenseId} and user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM defense_answers WHERE defense_id = #{defenseId} AND sq_id IS NOT NULL
mapper.select: SELECT answer_id, defense_id, question_id, sq_id, student_answer, score, feedback, created_at FROM defense_answers WHERE defense_id = #{defenseId} ORDER BY answer_id ASC
